== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Elysia, also known as the [[City of Light]], is a territory designed to maintain order among other territories. It is characterized by its immense, shining walls and a landscape of grassy plains filled with white and gold flowers. The city's architecture is grand, featuring soaring towers, silver spires, red brick structures, and massive amethysts. Within the city, streets are paved with white [[stone]], and buildings are constructed from gold and gold-colored materials. The doors of these buildings are various colors that signify their specific functions, often bearing a symbol resembling a scepter or winged staff. The city is associated with a golden power that can be drawn upon to manifest light-based weapons or energy, though doing so requires significant mental and physical effort. This power is linked to a system of [[nine virtues]], with selflessness being a central concept. Legend suggests the city is a paradise for those who are virtuous. Elysia also possesses unique properties, such as gates that typically only open once per day and a connection to various creatures. The entity is also tied to the concept of an [[Incarnation]], with historical figures such as the first [[Elysian Traveler]] having significant roles in its history.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Known as the [[City of Light]], Elysia serves as the tenth [[Territory]] and is situated beyond a Gate that only opens once daily while the sun is in the sky. The city is characterized by soaring towers, gleaming rooftops, and walls of pale white [[stone]] and pure gold that feature swirling patterns and stretch at least fifteen paces high. Under a bright, rich golden sky, the landscape consists of gold sections and silver-and-diamond parapets that create a city of rainbows. Although it is not an ideal location for long-distance traveling, Elysia contains impressive virtues and powers. [[Alin]] is able to wrench a bolt of light from the city and can call upon it as an item for power.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As the tenth [[Territory]], Elysia serves as a [[City of Light]] that represents the enlightened virtues of man and acts as a complement to every other [[Territory]]. More than three hundred years ago, this realm functioned as the guardian of the [[Incarnations]], and its walls possess the strength to defend against a foreign [[Incarnation]]. Although it is noted that the [[Territory]] may sometimes lack defenses, [[Alin]] can reach through space into Elysia and draw power from its presence. During his journey, [[Alin]] feels the sunny light of the realm over his shoulder and uses it to summon a green shield. Additionally, Elysia has served as a location where [[Grandmaster Naraka]] was taken to undergo healing.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Elysia is an ancient, warm city composed of nine colorful districts, including a [[Gold District]], a [[Violet District]], and a small white section. Characterized by an eternal sunrise and protected by an invisible barrier at its Gate, the city is represented by a symbol of a rising sun behind a downward-pointing winged [[sword]]. Though it once fought [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], the city now faces threats from [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]], who intends to loot its treasures, and [[Incarnations]] whose primary objective is to eliminate both [[Alin]] and Elysia. As the King moves against the city, a battle occurs within its walls, where gold-armored, winged warriors defend the location. Those who return to this [[City of Light]] become part of its fabric and are unable to leave, as the essence of the [[Blue Light]] returns to Elysia upon its dissolution.}}
